title: Seasons and Weather Quiz
description: Let's see what you learned about the four seasons and weather that God created!

questions.question: What color do leaves turn in the fall?
questions.explanation: In fall, God paints the leaves beautiful colors — red, orange, yellow, and brown!

questions.question: What does God send in the winter?
questions.explanation: God sends snow in winter! The Bible says 'He spreads the snow like wool' (Psalm 147:16).

questions.question: What happens to flowers in the spring?
questions.explanation: In spring, flowers bloom and grow! God sends rain to water them and sunshine to help them grow.

questions.question: What makes summer warm?
questions.explanation: God made the sun to give us warmth and light, making summer the warmest season!

questions.question: What does God put in the sky after it rains?
questions.explanation: God puts a rainbow in the sky after it rains as His special promise to us!
